=== Two cursors pass every key to the editor
--- given
- a
- b‸
- c‸
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸
- c‸

=== A bullet-shaped line inside frontmatter is not a list
--- given
---
tags:
- a‸
---
--- nodes 2 hmd-frontmatter
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
---
tags:
- a‸
---

=== A bullet-shaped line inside a table is not a list
--- given
- a
- b‸
--- nodes 1 HyperMD-table-row_HyperMD-table-row-1
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸

=== A list inside a callout is left to the editor
--- given
- a
- b‸
--- nodes 1 HyperMD-quote_HyperMD-quote-1 HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸

=== A cursor on a paragraph passes every key to the editor
--- given
- a
para‸graph
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
para‸graph

=== A cursor on the blank line of a loose list passes to the editor
--- given
- a
‸
- b
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
‸
- b

=== Move up refuses a list that mixes tabs and spaces
--- given
- a
	- a1
- b
  - b1‸
--- when command move-up
--- then passthrough
- a
	- a1
- b
  - b1‸

=== Indented lines with no bullet above them are not a list
--- given
    code‸
- a
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
    code‸
- a

=== The list ends at a paragraph that follows it
--- given
- a
- b‸
paragraph
- c
--- when command move-down
--- then consumed
- a
- b‸
paragraph
- c

=== A list under a heading starts at its first bullet
--- given
# Title
- a
- b‸
--- when command move-up
--- then
# Title
- b‸
- a

=== Two cursors pass Backspace to the editor
--- given
-
- ‸b
- ‸c
--- when key Backspace
--- then passthrough
-
- ‸b
- ‸c

=== A bullet with no gap and no content is still an item
--- given
- a
-‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  -‸
